name: Daniel 'Danny' Riley
bio:
Danny Riley's fascination with motorsport began with late nights watching Formula 1 races with his dad. He pursued a degree in aerospace engineering, focusing on aerodynamics. After graduating, Danny interned at a small open-wheel racing team before landing a full-time role at Hitech Development. He's a meticulous wind tunnel operator, known for his ability to quickly identify subtle airflow anomalies and suggest innovative solutions. Danny's experience gives him an edge in understanding the real-world implications of wind tunnel data.

Danny's approach emphasizes practical application. He regularly communicates with the engineers, ensuring his findings are translated into tangible improvements on the car. He's particularly adept at identifying cost-effective solutions, often finding ways to maximize aerodynamic performance without requiring major design overhauls. His colleagues appreciate his 'big picture' thinking and his dedication to the team's success. Loyalty is a core value, and he's known to be a dedicated and reliable team member.

physical.description: Danny is of average height with a slender build and an intense focus in his eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Has a habit of humming quietly while analyzing data.
Drinks black coffee throughout the day, always from the same mug.
